Applin

Grass Dragon

Galar · Generation 8

Applin is a Grass/Dragon-type Apple Core Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 0.5 kg. It evolves into Flapple, Appletun and Dipplin. Its highest base stat is Defense (80), with a base stat total of 260.
